decisions.reason: As a multi-model line close to the firm's handcrafted core and backed by an earlier public launch, management is likely to continue it to justify the investment unless there is unmistakable failure.
This pyramid variant sits squarely in the traditional seasonal assortment, so an established German craft firm would usually retain it rather than admit a misstep after several seasons.

Because the electronic music box was presented as a flagship direction in several models, escalation of commitment makes management especially reluctant to withdraw it and concede that the strategic push was wrong.

This add-on depends on the music-box concept but is easier to cut than the flagship itself, so after several years management is more likely to prune it and redirect resources while still defending the main platform.
Although it is a specific motif, it builds on the firm's established pyramid business and can be kept as part of the broad seasonal range with limited pressure to withdraw.
